name: comp-104
title: Volume Control Buttons
blurb: Volume slider using plus and minus buttons with icons that change based on…
description: A stateful volume control with increment/decrement buttons, a numeric display (0-6), and a volume icon that updates based on the current level. Uses aria-live for updates.
use_when: Controlling audio volume with a discrete numeric scale and clear icon feedback.
avoid_when: When a continuous slider is more appropriate or when volume is not the focus.
a11y: Uses aria-live for state announcements, aria-label for current volume, aria-labelledby for group context, and sr-only for screen reader text.
